name: Evidence Synthesis
description: Structured review of multiple studies, experiments, reports, or evaluations.

tasks.name: Define synthesis protocol
tasks.objective: Define the research question, populations/contexts, outcomes, eligible evidence, exclusions, time window, search sources, extraction schema, and quality criteria before screening results.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Inclusion/exclusion rules are decided before outcome-aware screening.

tasks.name: Retrieve and screen
tasks.objective: Search systematically, deduplicate records, screen against the protocol, and log exclusion reasons. Preserve near-misses that may explain scope limitations.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every included item satisfies the same eligibility rules.
Exclusions are reproducible from the log.

tasks.name: Extract comparable evidence
tasks.objective: Extract design, sample/context, intervention/exposure, comparator, outcomes, effect estimates, uncertainty, limitations, funding/conflicts, and relevant implementation details into a common schema.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Equivalent concepts are normalized without erasing material differences.

tasks.name: Appraise methods
tasks.objective: Assess bias, confounding, missingness, measurement quality, external validity, statistical precision, preregistration/replication where relevant, and whether conclusions match each source's actual design.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Study weight reflects methodological strength, not rhetorical confidence.

tasks.name: Synthesize patterns and contradictions
tasks.objective: Group comparable evidence, quantify where defensible, otherwise synthesize narratively. Explain heterogeneity and contradictory results before offering pooled conclusions.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Contradictory evidence is explained or preserved, not averaged away.

tasks.name: Grade conclusion strength
tasks.objective: Independently challenge each conclusion for overreach, publication bias, selective populations, time mismatch, and dependence among sources. State what evidence would change the conclusion.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Conclusion strength is proportional to evidence quality and consistency.
